features:
Key Features:

10 grams of protein per bar to help support muscle recovery and keep you feeling full longer.

Good source of fiber, providing digestive support and added satiety.

Gluten-free and made with real roasted peanuts, chocolate chips, and peanut butter.

No artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup, offering a more natural snack choice.

Convenient on-the-go packaging—ideal for busy mornings, outdoor activities, or post-workout snacks.

Benefits:

High protein and fiber content helps curb hunger and provides sustained energy.

Supports active lifestyles, whether you're working out, traveling, or need a quick pick-me-up at work.

Appeals to dietary needs, including gluten-free diets, while still delivering great taste.

Satisfies sweet and salty cravings in a balanced way—thanks to real ingredients like peanuts and chocolate.

Great alternative to candy bars or overly sugary snacks, with more nutritional value.
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Semisweet Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Vegetable Oils (palm, palm kernel, canola, peanut), Sugar, Whey Protein Concentrate, Corn Syrup, Fructose, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Vegetable Glycerin, Rice Starch, Cocoa, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Corn Starch, Natural Flavor.
